title: WarpAX: Observer-robust energy condition verification for warp drive spacetimes
description: JAX tools for curvature, energy conditions, and geodesics in prescribed spacetimes. Includes numerical LMI tests, observer optimization, exact checks for supplied rational certificates, interval enclosures on supported domains, and source-consistency diagnostics. Finite-segment energy integrals and grid diagnostics carry explicit limits.
